rule_text: Every car must wait at least 1.5 seconds in the waiting zone before it crosses the stop line.

muse_rule.normalized_explanation: Every car that crosses the stop line to_left must have first dwelled stopped at least 1500 ms continuously in the waiting zone.

assumptions: 'wait' interpreted as stopped still dwell, so DWELL max_speed 0.05
crossing means travel direction left-to-right, which per line mapping is direction to_left
BEFORE has no time limit, any earlier qualifying dwell satisfies
objects that never cross pass vacuously
anchor center chosen because top-down waiting zone and stop line are drawn for object centers
